calendly-api.free_tier: Free: API reads and most writes work on every plan incl. Free (except 3 Enterprise-only endpoints); booking through the Scheduling API (POST /invitees) and webhooks need a paid plan

groq-api.notes: Free-tier limits vary by model (e.g. 30 RPM / 1K RPD); see console.groq.com/settings/limits. Not to be confused with xAI Grok. Llama 3.x models (llama-3.3-70b-versatile, llama-3.1-8b-instant) are now contact-sales, not self-serve per-token

murf-ai-api.notes: Two model families: Falcon 2 (low latency, for streaming; $0.01/min) and Gen2 (studio quality).

languagetool-api.notes: This is a proofreading/grammar API, not machine translation. The keyless host api.languagetool.org is documented only on dev.languagetool.org/public-http-api; the OpenAPI spec lists only the Premium host

d-id-api.free_tier: Trial: 14 days with 3 minutes of video credits, then paid plans only (API price per minute not published in machine-readable form)

wise-api.notes: Personal tokens cover only quotes, recipients, transfers, batch groups and transfer events; funding and balance statements only for US/CA/AU/NZ/SG/MY accounts. Full access needs a partnership agreement. Docs use versioned paths, e.g. https://api.wise.com/2026Q3/profiles/{profileId}/quotes

stable-audio-api-stability-ai.desc_en: Generate music and sound effects from text prompts via REST API (Stable Audio 2.5, or Stable Audio 3.0 for tracks up to 6 minutes).
stable-audio-api-stability-ai.notes: Endpoint POST /v2beta/audio/stable-audio-2/text-to-audio; default model 2.5 costs 20 credits per generation; Stable Audio 3.0 (up to 6 min, async) costs 26 credits. Shares the platform.stability.ai credit system with Stability's image API.

unstructured-api.notes: Legacy /general/v0/general Partition endpoint is for prototyping single files; production use should use the Workflow API. Hosted Transform MCP parses documents; the UNS-MCP repo only manages connectors/workflows and is no longer maintained. Current parse endpoint: POST https://transform.unstructured.io/api/v2/parse with header unstructured-api-key

gitingest.notes: GET /api/{user}/{repo} or POST /api/ingest (include/exclude patterns); digest returned inline (summary, tree, content) plus a download URL. For heavy use the vendor recommends the open-source CLI (pip install gitingest).

gumloop.notes: Added: widely used AI-native automation builder with an official API, SDKs, and hosted MCP server. Trial converts to paid Pro ($37/mo) unless cancelled. The MCP server authenticates via OAuth sign-in, not a pasted key. Personal API keys also need the header x-auth-key: <user_id>, and API keys require the Pro plan or higher

apify.notes: MCP search/docs tools work unauthenticated; running paid Actors consumes platform usage credit. Actor endpoints use /v2/actors/{actorId}/... (e.g. run-sync-get-dataset-items)

cohere-api.notes: Vendor MCP at https://docs.cohere.com/_mcp/server only searches the docs. Trial keys are not for production use. v2 API is current; v1 is legacy. Flagship chat model: command-a-plus-05-2026

penpot-api.notes: API is RPC-style; methods are listed at https://design.penpot.app/api/main/methods/<name>, no OpenAPI file; open source, self-hostable. Remote MCP takes ?userToken=<MCP key> and needs the MCP plugin open in a Penpot browser tab; local: npx @penpot/mcp@stable.

coda-api-superhuman-docs.notes: Coda was rebranded to 'Superhuman Docs' after Grammarly's acquisition; the API base URL coda.io/apis/v1 still works, and the OpenAPI spec now names https://docs.superhuman.com/apis/v1. The official MCP server uses OAuth via id.superhuman.com (scope mcp:all).

mistral-ocr-api.notes: Current model: Mistral OCR 4; block/table/bounding-box extraction requires OCR 4+/2512+; no official Mistral-maintained MCP server, only community implementations.

amazon-selling-partner-api.notes: Self-authorized (private) apps for your own seller account are relatively quick to set up; public apps serving other sellers require Amazon's app-approval review. Official MCP uses Seller Central OAuth consent. Orders v0 getOrders is deprecated; use searchOrders (v2026-01-01). Planned SP-API fees were cancelled

scrapegraphai-api.free_tier: Trial: 500 API credits one-time on the Free plan (10 requests/min), no card required

line-messaging-api.free_tier: Free Communication plan (Japan): 200 push/broadcast messages/month; reply messages are unlimited. Beyond that only paid plans (Light JPY 5,000 for 5,000 messages, Standard JPY 15,000 for 30,000). Free quotas vary by region

nocodb-cloud.notes: Free plan API quota is very small (1,000 calls/month). v3 Data API reference at https://nocodb.com/apis/v3/data/ (base https://app.nocodb.com; xc-token or Authorization: Bearer) and Meta API at https://meta-apis-v3.nocodb.com/. Remote MCP over Streamable HTTP; tools follow the token owner's base role and plan-gated features.

amazon-translate.notes: Requires an AWS account and IAM credentials. The generic AWS API MCP Server (awslabs) can call Translate via AWS CLI commands.

keboola.notes: Remote MCP URL is per stack: mcp.keboola.com is US Virginia (AWS) only; others e.g. mcp.eu-central-1.keboola.com; local server at github.com/keboola/mcp-server. Jobs consume the monthly compute minutes; inactive accounts out of credits are suspended after 2 months. Storage API reference: https://api.keboola.com/?service=storage (the Apiary docs are retired)

pipedrive-api.notes: Official hosted MCP at mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp uses Pipedrive account sign-in (OAuth). Offers a free Sandbox account for development/testing separate from production pricing. Core endpoints (e.g. POST /deals) are v2 only: https://api.pipedrive.com/api/v2/deals; v1 remains for the rest

postman-api.notes: Reference docs are at learning.postman.com. Remote MCP modes: /minimal (default), /code, /mcp (full, 100+ tools); US host supports OAuth, EU host mcp.eu.postman.com needs an API key. Docs-search MCP at learning.postman.com/_mcp/server. API host https://api.postman.com (EU: api.eu.postman.com); api.getpostman.com is legacy

stackone.desc_en: Call 520+ SaaS connectors (HRIS, ATS, CRM, documents) through one unified API or MCP gateway covering 32,000+ actions.
stackone.notes: Plans: Starter free (1,000 credits per seat per month), Team $600/month, Enterprise quote-based.

vercel-sandbox.notes: Pricing = active CPU + provisioned memory + per Sandbox.create() call + data transfer; 64 GB ephemeral NVMe per sandbox (SDK 3.0.0+ and custom images).

freepik-api.desc_en: Generate and edit images, and generate video, music and sound effects via REST API, plus access the Freepik stock asset library.

youtube-data-api.notes: Daily quota of 10,000 units shared across most calls; search.list costs 1 unit from a separate Search Queries bucket capped at 100 calls/day.

spider-cloud.free_tier: Free: keyless /scrape endpoint, rate-limited (quota not published); other endpoints return 402 without a key

browser-use-cloud-api.notes: Pay-as-you-go: model cost + 20% and browsers at $0.02/hour, no per-run fees; no ongoing free tier beyond the signup credit.

parallel-web-systems-search-api.notes: The remote MCP server works without an account/API key at lower rate limits; an Authorization: Bearer key raises them. The main REST API requires an API key from the dashboard. Search defaults to mode advanced ($5 per 1,000 requests); set mode fast for $1 per 1,000

merge-agent-handler.notes: Separate product from Merge's classic Unified API (HRIS/ATS/CRM sync); Agent Handler is the AI-agent-facing tool-calling layer. All plans include unlimited registered users and tool packs. An agent can sign up without a human: POST https://ah-api.merge.dev/api/v1/agent/signup/ (no auth) creates an organization and returns an API key

google-gemini-api.notes: Vendor MCP at https://gemini-api-docs-mcp.dev only searches the docs. Free-tier content may be used to improve Google products. Unrestricted standard API keys are rejected in 2026; use a current key type. Google publishes a Discovery document, not OpenAPI. The quickstart now uses POST /v1beta/interactions (header Api-Revision: 2026-05-20) rather than generateContent

you-com-api.free_tier: Free: 100 queries/day with no API key or sign-up through the MCP free profile (search and discover only); new API-key accounts also get $100 in one-time credit

zendesk-api.free_tier: Trial: 14-day free trial of Suite Professional, one-time, no credit card required; no free plan, paid plans from $19/agent/mo (Support Team, annual)

aws-textract.free_tier: Trial: new AWS customers get 3 months free, per month 1,000 pages DetectDocumentText, 100 pages AnalyzeDocument forms/tables/layout/queries, 100 AnalyzeExpense/AnalyzeID, 2,000 pages AnalyzeLending; card required

zoo-text-to-cad-api-kittycad.desc_en: Convert CAD files and run modeling operations via REST API; text-to-CAD generation runs through the WebSocket copilot and the MCP server.
zoo-text-to-cad-api-kittycad.notes: The current OpenAPI spec at api.zoo.dev has no REST endpoint that creates a text-to-CAD model (only list/get of past results); generation runs over WebSocket copilot endpoints or the MCP server.

piston.desc_en: Compile and run code in 70+ languages inside isolated containers via a self-hostable REST API (the public instance needs a granted token).
piston.free_tier: Free: self-host (open source, Docker); public emkc.org API closed to open use since 2026-02-15, tokens only for approved non-commercial educational projects

leonardo-ai-api.notes: API credit is bought separately from web app subscriptions. The official MCP (https://mcp.leonardo.ai/v1/mcp) authenticates with an 'API-Key' header, not OAuth. Image generation is documented on v2: POST https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v2/generations (model + parameters.prompt).

meshy-api.notes: Free web accounts get only a limited built-in Playground key; creating/managing your own API keys requires a paid subscription. Text-to-3D is on /openapi/v2/text-to-3d (other endpoints stay on /openapi/v1).

akool-api.note: the Free plan is web-app only; API access starts at Pro Max

plivo.desc_en: Make and receive voice calls, SIP trunking and AI voice agents via REST API; SMS is available only on the Enterprise plan.
plivo.free_tier: Trial: free credits for the first 3 weeks on the self-serve Professional plan (voice and SIP only); SMS, MMS and WhatsApp need Enterprise (from $1,000/month)
plivo.notes: Self-serve onboarding covers voice and SIP only: "Self-service onboarding for SMS is not currently available"; SMS needs the Enterprise plan (from $1,000/month). Professional plan usage is capped at $2,500/month. Signup needs a business email and phone verification. The MCP at plivo.com/docs/mcp only searches docs.

telnyx.free_tier: Trial: $5 test credit, 1 verified number, 100 messages/day; then paid (US 10DLC $0.004/SMS part + carrier fees)

twilio.free_tier: Trial: 100 SMS, 100 WhatsApp, 3,000 emails, 75 voice minutes; no card; one-time, expires after 30 days; SMS only to verified numbers within the signup country, using predefined templates

hyperbrowser.free_tier: Free: Free plan with 5,000 credits (1 credit = $0.001), 1 concurrent browser, 7-day data retention; no credit card required

stability-ai-3d-stable-fast-3d-spar3d-ap.free_tier: Trial: 25 free credits on signup (1 credit = $0.01), then pay-as-you-go

tripo-api.free_tier: Trial: starter free credits (Tripo docs: 300 free credits; amount varies by signup path), then pay-as-you-go at $0.01/credit

deepl-api.free_tier: Free: API Developer plan ('Test out the API for free', EUR 0 base price, 1,000,000 characters/month in the pricing data); legacy API Free keys (:fx) use api-free.deepl.com

codesandbox-sdk.free_tier: Free: Build (free) plan with 400 VM credits/month (~40 Nano-VM hours) and up to 10 concurrent VMs

vonage-api.free_tier: Trial: free credit on signup, no credit card required; then pay-as-you-go per request

synthflow-api.free_tier: Paid only: Enterprise contracts from $30,000/year; no free plan or self-serve trial listed

cal-com-api.free_tier: Free: API keys on any account incl. the free-forever Individuals plan, 120 req/min per key (higher on request); Teams/Orgs endpoints need paid plans

microsoft-graph-outlook-teams-onedrive.free_tier: Free: standard Graph APIs cost nothing beyond the user's Microsoft 365/Entra license (metered APIs are billed); the free M365 E5 developer sandbox is only for qualifying members (Visual Studio Pro/Enterprise subscribers, ISV Success/partners, Premier/Unified support)

todoist-api.free_tier: Free: API usable with any Todoist account; 1,000 partial / 100 full sync requests per 15 min per user; some features follow the user's Todoist plan

trello-api.free_tier: Free: free API key + user token; rate limits 300 req/10 s per API key and 100 req/10 s per token

mastodon-api.free_tier: Free: register an app per instance at no cost; default limit 300 requests per 5 minutes per account

meta-graph-api-facebook-instagram.free_tier: Free: no fee; platform rate limit 200 calls/hour x app users; most non-trivial permissions need Meta App Review and business verification

pinterest-api.free_tier: Free: new apps get Trial access (1,000 requests/day); Standard access (100 req/s per user per app) requires app review

reddit-api.free_tier: Free: Data API usable within Reddit's rate limits under the Data API Terms; commercial use or research above rate limits needs a separate agreement with Reddit

tiktok-api.free_tier: Free: no fee; default 600 requests/min per endpoint; app review needed for production, unaudited clients post private-only

here-location-services.free_tier: Free: Base plan includes free monthly transactions per service (pay-as-you-grow above); credit card required at signup

bigcommerce-api.free_tier: Trial: free 15-day trial store to test the API (partners can create sandbox stores); ongoing use needs a paid BigCommerce plan

etsy-open-api-v3.free_tier: Free: developer keystring at no cost; per-app QPS/QPD rate limits shown in the Developer Portal

mercado-libre-api.free_tier: Free: create an app in DevCenter with a Mercado Libre account (no API fee); rate limited (HTTP 429); marketplace selling fees still apply

printful-api.free_tier: Free: no monthly fee for API/store connection (pay only for fulfillment); 120 API calls/min general rate limit

shopify-admin-storefront-api.free_tier: Free: unlimited free dev stores via a free Partner account/Dev Dashboard for building and testing (no real transactions); live merchant stores need a paid Shopify plan

woocommerce-rest-api.free_tier: Free: open-source WordPress plugin, free to download and use; no platform fees, only your own hosting costs

paragon-actionkit.free_tier: Trial: free trial ('Start free trial'); no lasting free tier; pricing by custom quote based on Connected Users
